title: Build Your Own CRM with AI: Replace Salesforce for $0/Month in Fees
summary: Build your own CRM with AI and replace Salesforce for $0 in per-seat fees. Real cost breakdown, step-by-step build guide, and honest comparison — what you gain and what you give up.
body_markdown: For teams of 3–25 people focused on pipeline management, contact tracking, and activity logging, yes. Salesforce's value compounds at enterprise scale — territory management, complex CPQ, deep forecasting, compliance certifications. If those aren't requirements, a custom CRM covering your actual workflows outperforms Salesforce on simplicity and cost. The teams that struggle with custom CRMs are those with existing Salesforce integrations they can't easily unwind.
